title: Singlet-oxygen-driven stereoselective iodothiocyanation and iodoselenocyanation of alkynes
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,760-769
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00867K, Communication
Open Access

Mahima Gupta, Ashwini Vishwasrao Katkar, Vaibhav Pramod Charpe, Kuo Chu Hwang
Presenting a low-energy visible light enabled, metal-free cross-coupling of alkynes with iodine and NH4SCN/KSeCN under O2 at room temperature, generating I˙, 1O2, and SCN/SeCN˙ to afford stereoselective E-iodo-vinyl thio- and selenocyanates.
